detail: docs/compatibility.md carries a generated promotion-state block, and its counts still read 11 Stable and 10 Preview after linux-qt-widgets and windows-winui were promoted on executed field campaigns. The regeneration was produced while resolving a merge conflict across four campaign worktrees, but only SUPPORT.md and validation/compatibility/ were committed with it, so this one generated surface was left dirty in the working tree. That is not cosmetic: validation/compatibility/check.py --check-generated compares every generated surface against a fresh render and exits 1 on any drift, so CI would have gone red on the next push. Verified both ways before committing rather than assumed: --check-generated exits 1 with the regeneration stashed and 0 with it applied. Counts now read 12 Stable, 9 Preview, 0 Experimental. No product code changes.
